title: My Weekend
subtitle: Free-time activities · Simple past with didn't · go + -ing

p: O weekend (fim de semana) é um tempo para relaxar e fazer coisas divertidas. Às vezes ficamos em casa; outras vezes saímos, visitamos lugares e encontramos amigos.

Atividades: eat out (comer fora), go to the movies (ir ao cinema), visit a museum (visitar um museu), go on a picnic (fazer piquenique), stay home (ficar em casa), go to the beach (ir à praia), text my friends (mandar mensagem para os amigos).
Palavras para descrever: win (ganhar) e lose (perder) um jogo; exciting (emocionante), interesting (interessante), busy (ocupado) e boring (chato).

scenes.alt: Família à mesa de um restaurante, atendida por um garçom.

p: Muitas atividades de lazer em inglês usam go + verbo com -ing: go swimming (nadar), go fishing (pescar), go hiking (fazer trilha), go horseback riding (andar a cavalo), go ice skating (patinar no gelo).
No presente: We usually go hiking. No passado, go vira went: We went swimming. Na negativa: We didn't go hiking.
Perguntas do livro: What do you do on weekends? (o que você costuma fazer) e What did you do last weekend? (o que você fez no fim de semana passado).

grammar: go swimming · go fishing · go hiking

theory.h: Didn't: what you did NOT do
p: Para dizer que algo não aconteceu no passado, usamos didn't + verbo na forma normal: I didn't go to the movies. I didn't eat out. I stayed home.
Compare: We went to the beach. (fomos) × We didn't go to the beach. (não fomos). We won! (ganhamos) × We didn't win. We lost. (não ganhamos, perdemos).
Cuidado: depois de didn't o verbo NÃO vai para o passado. Certo: I didn't watch TV. Errado: I didn't watched TV.
Perguntas com wh-: How was your weekend? → It was boring. I didn't do anything special. / What did you do? → I went to a soccer game. / Did your team win? → No, they didn't win. They lost.

scenes.alt: Crianças leem e jogam juntas na sala de casa.

grammar: I didn't go to the movies.
We didn't go to the beach.
Use didn't go, didn't win, didn't watch.

p: O texto fala do Children's Museum (Museu das Crianças) em Indianapolis, USA. Do lado de fora há modelos gigantes de dinossauros: alguns parecem fugir e outros olham pela janela.
Dentro do museu há fósseis de dinossauros de verdade e salas de ciência, arte, cultura e história. Na exposição Treasures of the Earth aprende-se sobre a história do Egito.
Você pode aprender sobre as estrelas no planetarium (planetário), ir ao theater (teatro) e até fazer rock climbing (escalada)!

Complemento de leitura: palavras como first, then, next e after that ajudam a acompanhar a ordem dos acontecimentos. Para esta prova, priorize compreender as atividades e dizer o que aconteceu ou não aconteceu com didn't + verbo na forma base.

Treino de leitura: On Saturday, Ben visited a museum with his sister. They saw dinosaur fossils. Then they went to the planetarium and learned about the stars. They wanted to see a play, but the theater was closed. They did not go to the theater.

scenes.pt: Um museu pode ter exposições de dinossauros. Ilustração imaginada; não é uma reprodução do museu citado no texto.

games.title: Memória do fim de semana
games.instructions: Ache cada atividade e o seu significado.

games.title: Did or didn't?
games.instructions: Leia a pista e complete a frase com a forma certa.

items.text: We canceled our picnic because of the rain. We __ on a picnic. 🌧️
We __ to the movies. We watched a film at the cinema! 🎬
The beach trip was canceled. We __ to the beach. ⛈️
Last Sunday I __ fishing with my dad. We caught two fish! 🎣
I was sick and stayed home all day. I __ to the party. 🤒
We __ swimming. We swam in the pool for an hour! 🏊

games.title: What did they do?
games.instructions: Leia o que aconteceu e escolha a frase que expressa a mesma informação.
pairs: Our team won the final game.
We had every meal at home on Sunday.
The TV was broken. I played video games on my computer instead.
We took a blanket and lunch to the park and ate on the grass.

games.title: How did they feel?
games.instructions: A frase descreve um fim de semana divertido ou chato?

items.text: The game was exciting! We cheered and shouted. 🤩
I was bored all day. Nothing interested me. 🥱
The museum visit was exciting. I loved the dinosaurs! 🦖
The film was boring. I wanted it to end. 🥱
I stayed home and played a new game. It was exciting! 🎮
I went out, but the show was boring. I felt bored. 🥱

games.title: Long answers with didn't
games.instructions: Escolha a resposta completa. ❌ indica que a ação não aconteceu.
pairs: No, they didn't visit a museum.
No, he didn't text his friends.
No, I didn't win the game.
No, they didn't go horseback riding.

quiz.q: Ouça e escolha o significado da atividade.
quiz.explain: Go hiking é fazer trilha (caminhar na natureza). Pescar é go fishing, nadar é go swimming e patinar no gelo é go ice skating.

quiz.q: Como se diz “ir ao cinema” em inglês?
quiz.explain: Go to the movies = ir ao cinema.

quiz.q: O piquenique foi cancelado por causa da chuva. Complete: “We ______ on a picnic.”
quiz.explain: A pista informa que o passeio foi cancelado: didn't go. Depois de didn't usamos go, nunca went.

quiz.q: Complete: “We played basketball on Saturday. We ________. We lost!”
quiz.explain: Se perderam (lost), então não ganharam: didn't win.
Depois de didn't o verbo fica na forma normal: I didn't watch TV.

quiz.q: “How was your weekend?” Qual resposta faz sentido?
options: It was boring. I didn't do anything special.
Yes, I did. I liked it a lot.
I go to school every Monday.
It is Monday and it is sunny.
quiz.explain: How was…? pergunta como foi. A resposta descreve o fim de semana: It was boring (foi chato).

quiz.q: “What did you do last weekend?” Escolha a melhor resposta.
quiz.explain: Last weekend é passado, então a resposta usa went: I went swimming.

quiz.q: Ouça a frase e escolha o que ela quer dizer.
quiz.listen: I didn't eat out. I stayed home.
options: Não comi fora. Fiquei em casa.
Comi fora. Não fiquei em casa.
Fui ao cinema e comi pipoca.
quiz.explain: Didn't eat out = não comi fora. Stayed home = fiquei em casa.
Exciting = emocionante. Boring = chato, busy = ocupado, interesting = interessante.

quiz.q: Leia o texto. Where did Ben learn about the stars?
quiz.explain: O texto diz que Ben e a irmã foram ao planetário e aprenderam sobre as estrelas.
quiz.context: On Saturday, Ben visited a museum with his sister. They saw dinosaur fossils. Then they went to the planetarium and learned about the stars. They wanted to see a play, but the theater was closed. They did not go to the theater.

quiz.q: Leia o texto. Why didn't Ben go to the theater?
quiz.explain: O teatro estava fechado. A palavra but apresenta o obstáculo ao plano de assistir à peça.
quiz.context: On Saturday, Ben visited a museum with his sister. They saw dinosaur fossils. Then they went to the planetarium and learned about the stars. They wanted to see a play, but the theater was closed. They did not go to the theater.

quiz.q: Leia o texto. Which activity did Ben NOT do?
quiz.explain: Ben realizou as outras três atividades. O texto informa que ele não foi ao teatro.
quiz.context: On Saturday, Ben visited a museum with his sister. They saw dinosaur fossils. Then they went to the planetarium and learned about the stars. They wanted to see a play, but the theater was closed. They did not go to the theater.

quiz.explain: A instrução pede go + -ing: go swimming. Swimming sozinho não inclui go; went swimming está no passado.

quiz.q: Responda com a frase inteira: “Did you go hiking?” ❌ Comece com “No, I…” e use go hiking.
quiz.explain: Depois de didn't, use go: No, I didn't go hiking.

quiz.q: Responda com a frase inteira: “Did she eat out?” ❌ Comece com “No, she…” e use eat out.
quiz.explain: Depois de didn't, use eat, não ate: No, she didn't eat out.

quiz.q: Responda com a frase inteira: “Did they visit a museum?” ❌ Comece com “No, they…” e use visit a museum.
answers: No, they didn't visit a museum.
quiz.explain: A resposta mantém they e usa didn't visit: No, they didn't visit a museum.

quiz.q: Ouça o diálogo. What did Sam do on Sunday?
quiz.explain: Sam diz que não foi nadar. Ele foi pescar com o pai.
quiz.listen: Emma: Did you go swimming on Sunday? Sam: No, I did not go swimming. I went fishing with my dad. Emma: Did you catch any fish? Sam: Yes, I did.

quiz.q: “Lia texted her friends yesterday.” Qual frase diz que ela NÃO fez isso?
options: She didn't text her friends yesterday.
She didn't texted her friends yesterday.
She doesn't texted her friends yesterday.
She did text her friends yesterday.
quiz.explain: Didn't pede a forma base text, sem -ed. She did text é afirmativa, não negativa.
